title: Flock device inventory, decommissions, invoices, POs
summary:
Asked for a complete list of Flock devices (location, model, ALPR capability, ownership, installation date), any decommissioned devices since January 2023, and all invoices and payment records.

Produced Flock Camera Manager screenshots showing 80 devices, a curated spreadsheet listing 60 active devices, and invoices/POs from January 2023 forward.
filed_because: Inventory and spend baseline. The actual device count, locations, types, and contract totals are the underlying numbers other PRAs draw on.
notes:
The 80-vs-60 difference was clarified: 'in planning' devices in the Flock platform are rejected locations Flock is removing.

Invoice records inform the per-device cost basis used in W012460-040226 (Council authorization for 2020 Flock deployment).

Parser initially marked the case 'needs_review' because the agency's clarification used informal sign-off rather than canonical closure language.
